complexity.notes: The float('inf') sentinel at the base of min_stack is a clean way to avoid an empty-check on the first push. An equivalent variant stores ||(value, current-min) pairs on a single stack||; it saves a second list but is the same idea and the same complexity.
complexity.summary: Maintains a parallel stack of the running minimum: push appends val to the min stack only when val is at most the current minimum, and pop pops the min stack only when the removed value equals it, so getMin is just the min stack's top.
